5	// at either value yet.

8	const TOTALS_COLUMN_WIDTH = '26.875rem'; // 430px

11	// (1280px) — reusing both aliases rather than inventing a third, per this component's own
12	// build-step scope note.
13	//
14	// The media-query string is inlined at each use site below (matching zimmDrawer.css.ts's own

18	// mobile-default properties with media-query-keyed overrides, so TypeScript resolves any

21	// see zimmCartDrawer.css.test.ts's own comment on the resulting `.toEqual(...)` workaround.
22	
23	export const ZimmCartDrawer = {
24	  parts: ['messages', 'body', 'footer'],
25	  baseStyle: {
26	    // Reserves height even with nothing to show — designer requirement: "to prevent the cart
27	    // changing position depending on errors". --zimm-scale-1300 = 52px (zimmTokens.ts:168).
28	    messages: {
29	      minHeight: 'var(--zimm-scale-1300)',
30	      paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xl)', // 32px — mobile/tablet page gutter
31	      [`@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.xl})`]: {
32	        paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-6xl)', // 128px — desktop page gutter
33	      },
34	    },
35	    // Mobile default: full-width single column, 32px gutter (spacing['2xl']).
36	    body: {
37	      display: 'flex',
38	      flexDirection: 'column',
39	      width: '100%',
40	      paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xl)',
41	      // Tablet step restated explicitly at its own breakpoint (same values as the mobile
42	      // default above — fluid width, NOT a computed pixel width) — see
43	      // .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md's "Responsive steps are explicit media queries".
44	      [`@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})`]: {
45	        display: 'flex',
46	        flexDirection: 'column',
47	        width: '100%',
48	        paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xl)',
49	      },
50	      // Desktop: two columns (items/totals), a 140px gap between them, and a 128px page gutter
51	      // each side.
52	      [`@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.xl})`]: {
53	        display: 'grid',
54	        gridTemplateColumns: `${ITEMS_COLUMN_WIDTH} ${TOTALS_COLUMN_WIDTH}`,
55	        columnGap: 'var(--zimm-scale-3500)', // 140px
56	        paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-6xl)', // 128px
57	      },
58	    },
59	    // No button-group content yet (SFCC-275, a later commit) — this part only carries the page

61	    footer: {
62	      paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xl)',
63	      [`@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.xl})`]: {
64	        paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-6xl)',
65	      },

input.message:
## Branch check
`feature/SFCC-11_cart` — confirmed via `git branch --show-current` before any edit, not `develop`/`main`.

## What I built (all 6 files the step named — nothing else touched)

- **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCartDrawer/index.tsx`** (new) — the organism. Wraps `ZimmDrawer` (`size="xLarge"`), derives `title` from `itemCount` (`itemCount === 0 ? 'YOUR BAG IS EMPTY' : \`BAG • ${itemCount}\``), and renders three always-present children inside it: `messages`, `body` (line items or the empty placeholder), `footer`.
- **`.../zimmCartDrawer.css.ts`** (new) — the recipe, exports `ZimmCartDrawer`, `parts: ['messages', 'body', 'footer']`.
- **`.../zimmCartDrawer.css.test.ts`** (new) — 7 tests against the recipe's resolved output.
- **`.../index.stories.tsx`** (new) — `Layout/ZimmCartDrawer`, `Default`/`Empty` stories with `play` assertions.
- **`.../index.test.tsx`** (new) — 8 tests (3 header-title branching + Escape/backdrop/close-button/focus-restore/scroll-restore).
- **`overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`** (modified) — Tier 2, pre-authorized per the build brief. Added one import + one entry, appended at the end of both the import block and the `components` object — matching the exact pattern the two most recent entries (`ZimmCartItem`, `ZimmCartItemVariant`) already establish (new recipes are appended chronologically, not alphabetized). `git diff` is a 2-line addition in each spot, nothing else touched.

## Pass criteria — evidence for each

**1–2 (Default/Empty header text + a11y-visible messages band).** Verified for real, not assumed: I ran `npm run build-storybook` then served `storybook-static` and ran `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook --ci` against it (the exact mechanism `.github/workflows/qa.yml`'s `storybook-test` job uses). Full run: **65 suites / 306 tests passed**, including `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCartDrawer/index.stories.tsx` by name in the output. Since `preview.tsx` sets `a11y.test: 'error'`, this run *is* the a11y gate (criterion 9) — a real violation would have failed it, not just my story's own `play`.

**3–4 (index.test.tsx behaviour).** `npx vitest run` → 15/15 pass, including:
- Escape → `onClose` called once.
- Backdrop click → `onClose` called once. Selector: `dialog.parentElement` — I traced this through `@chakra-ui/modal`'s actual source (`getDialogContainerProps` in `node_modules/@chakra-ui/modal/dist/index.js:184-193`) to confirm the click-to-close handler lives on `ZimmDrawerContent`'s own container div, not on `<DrawerOverlay>` (which I confirmed carries no `onClick` at all — purely visual).
- Close button click → `onClose` called once.
- Focus restore → `trigger` (the harness's own "Open bag" button) regains focus after close, via a real `waitFor` against real framer-motion (see judgment call below).
- Scroll restore → I read `zimmDrawer/index.tsx`'s lock first: it only ever saves/restores `document.body.style.overflow`, it has no scrollY logic at all. So the test independently pins `window.scrollY = 850` before opening and asserts it's still `850` after close — proving nothing resets scroll position, not just that overflow got unlocked.

**5 (responsive grid).** `zimmCartDrawer.css.test.ts` asserts, against the recipe's own resolved objects: mobile/tablet single-column + `var(--zimm-scale-2xl)` (32px) gutter, desktop `display:'grid'`, `gridTemplateColumns: '22.5rem 26.875rem'` (360/430px), `columnGap: var(--zimm-scale-3500)` (140px), `paddingInline: var(--zimm-scale-6xl)` (128px) — each keyed by its own explicit `@media (min-width: ...)` string. A dedicated test also greps the raw file text for `\d+\.\d+px` and the literal `659.2` and asserts neither appears.

**6 (recipeParts.test.ts).** Ran it directly with `--reporter=verbose`: `✓ ... > multipart recipes declare every part their component reads > zimmCartDrawer`. Every `styles.x` read in `index.tsx` (`messages`, `body`, `footer`) is declared in `parts`.

**7 (recipe naming/registration).** `export const ZimmCartDrawer = {...}`, registered in `theme/components/index.ts`. `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s "no recipe silently inherits a base SFCC recipe of the same name" test passed (6/6 in that file) — there is no base `ZimmCartDrawer`.

**8 (story title).** `title: 'Layout/ZimmCartDrawer'` — confirmed literal in the file.

**9 (a11y).** Covered under 1–2 above — actually ran the gate, not just trusted it would pass.

**Final full-suite runs (not scoped, not stale):** `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0, zero errors. `npm run test` → **88 test files / 1263 tests passed**.

## Recipe parts and why

- `messages` — the message band. `minHeight: var(--zimm-scale-1300)` unconditionally (confirmed = 52px at `zimmTokens.ts:168`), gutter 32px→128px at desktop. Always rendered by `index.tsx` regardless of `itemCount` or whether `messages` content is passed.
- `body` — the responsive layout: single column + 32px gutter at mobile and tablet (explicit, separately-declared media query per `overrideStyling.md`'s "responsive steps are explicit media queries" convention, even though tablet's values equal mobile's), two-column grid at desktop.
- `footer` — carries only the matching page gutter so the (not-yet-built) button group lines up once SFCC-275 lands; no other styling invented.

## Judgment calls made — flagging for your awareness, not hidden as fact

1. **"Desktop ≥1440" → I used `breakpoints.xl` (1280px), not a literal 1440px value.** The brief's prose says "≥1440" but also says "do not invent a third breakpoint alias," and pass criterion 5 itself only says "above the desktop breakpoint" (no number). `gridSystem.ts` already labels `xl` as *"1280px — desktop breakpoint"* verbatim in its own comment (line 17) — that's the only breakpoint in this codebase actually named "the desktop breakpoint."
